tickets.title: Reconcile bookkeeping balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the bookkeeping dashboard balance with the Teacup Comet Bank business checking account balance. Two client deposits were marked as received in the dashboard but have not settled in the bank account. Resolve the discrepancy before the next payment batch.
tickets.evidence: For bookkeeping balance reconciliation, the bookkeeping dashboard showed a higher available business balance than the Teacup Comet Bank business checking account because two client deposits were marked as received even though they had not settled in the bank account.

tickets.title: Separate business card feed from household spending tracker
tickets.text: Separate the Teacup Comet Bank business card feed from the household spending tracker to prevent contractor platform fees and design software charges from appearing in personal spending categories. Reconfigure the feed to assign business transactions to the business tracker.
tickets.evidence: For business card feed separation, the Teacup Comet Bank business card feed is importing into the household spending tracker, causing contractor platform fees and design software charges to appear in personal spending categories.

tickets.title: Coordinate quarterly tax reserve with CPA
tickets.text: Coordinate quarterly tax reserve planning with Harper Nettlewhisk of Paper Otter Tax. Provide projected gross receipts, expected deductible categories, Janelle’s planned owner draws, and Omar’s withholding information so the first self-employment tax reserve target can be estimated before the initial payment cycle for the new year. Use the secure portal for any financial document sharing.
tickets.evidence: Harper requested projected gross receipts, expected deductible categories, Janelle’s planned owner draws, and Omar’s withholding information so the first self-employment tax reserve target can be estimated before the initial payment cycle for the new year. The agreed follow-up is due 2025-01-17.
